'''Mieczysław Władysław Omyła''' (born 1941<ref>[https://www.bn.org.pl/download/document/1363783292.pdf Biblioteka Narodowa. Bibliografia Zawartości Czasopism]</ref>) is a Polish professor of humanities, logician, philosopher. He is a lecturer in logic and philosophy at the [[Cardinal Stefan Wyszyński University in Warsaw|Cardinal Stefan Wyszyński University]] in [[Warsaw]].<ref>[https://usosweb.uksw.edu.pl/kontroler.php?_action=katalog2/osoby/pokazOsobe&os_id=20 Mieczysław Omyła]. Usosweb.uksw.edu.pl (in Polish).</ref>

== Education and career ==
=== Biography ===
He comes from [[Soblówka]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.infoserwis-etnokultura.pl/r,3,342,680,Soblowka-Szkola-podstawowa.html|title=Soblówka - Szkoła podstawowa|website=www.infoserwis-etnokultura.pl|accessdate=13 March 2022}}</ref> He was a student of [[Roman Suszko]] and an associate of [[Bogusław Wolniewicz]]. 

He continued Suszko's logical and ontological works, often referring to Wolniewicz's [[ontology]] of the situation. In 1991 he became the Head of the Logic Department at the Institute of Philosophy of the [[University of Warsaw]]. In 1997 he obtained the academic title of professor of humanities.<ref name="naukapolska">[http://nauka-polska.pl/#/profile/scientist?id=29492  Prof. Mieczysław Władysław Omyła]. Baza „Ludzie nauki” portalu Nauka Polska (in Polish).</ref> He was a member of the Polish Semiotic Society ({{langx|pl|Polskie Towarzystwo Semiotyczne}}) and the [[Polish Academy of Sciences]] ({{langx|pl|Polska Akademia Nauk}}).<ref name="naukapolska" />

Janusz Wesserling obtained a PhD degree under his supervision, .<ref>[http://baza.biblioteka.uksw.edu.pl/makwww/makwww.exe?BM=03&IM=04&TX=&NU=01&WI=OMYlAbMIECZYSlAW UKSW Biblioteka: katalogi i bazy danych MAK]. Baza.biblioteka.uksw.edu.pl (in Polish).</ref>

== Selected works ==
* Paradygmat fregowski a teorie sytuacji ({{langx|en|The frigate paradigm and theories of the situation}}) (2009)<ref name="naukapolska" />
* Remarks on Non-Fregean Logic (2007)<ref name="naukapolska" />
* Homomorfizm semantyczny a reifikacja sytuacji ({{langx|en|Semantic homomorphism and reification of the situation}}) (2006)<ref name="naukapolska" />
* Aksjomat Fregego a ekstensjonalność ({{langx|en|Frege's axiom and extensionality}}) (2005)<ref name="naukapolska" />
